paras: Truong's gecko (Gekko truongi) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, truongi is in honor of Vietnamese herpetologist Truong Quang Nguyen.
G. truongi is found in southern Vietnam, in Khánh Hòa Province.
The preferred natural habitat of G. truongi is forest.
Medium-sized for its genus, G. truongi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 9.6 cm (3.8 in).
